name: perch-dashboard
description: A calm view over every Claude Code agent you have running — status, context, attention ranking, one click back to the terminal.

scripts.build-ext: cp public/style.css public/app.js extension/ && cp public/index.html extension/newtab.html
scripts.pack-ext: npm run build-ext && mkdir -p dist && cd extension && zip -rq ../dist/perch-extension.zip . -x '.*'
